deployment_policy: Run Blender, voice, transcription, translation and assembly as stage jobs on Serverless workers sharing the Asteriq network volume; do not use Pods.
purpose: Versioned, fail-closed source-video to animated-film production contract
source_video_policy: Every visible source performer requires a manual binding to one saved, versioned character and voice profile before a GPU job can start.

visual_style_policy.photorealism: blocked unless the project owner explicitly selects photorealistic output for this render

direct_3d_film.purpose: Create and render a 3D animated film without generating a 2D video as the source animation.
stages: image or text to reusable 3D character asset
direct_3d_film.asset_policy: Save each approved character and virtual set as a versioned reusable asset. Reference images guide design only; they never become a 2D animated-video intermediary.
direct_3d_film.quality_gate: Do not submit a direct 3D render until the character rig, clothing constraints, camera plan and virtual set pass review.

output.subtitle_style: yellow or black outline, no box
